title: Triage result (exeris-kernel)
description: The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's task classes, roles and scope vocabulary. The required fields and the `validation_gates` contract — a gate is never named without the risk it retires — are the base's; only the vocabulary is local. The base refuses nothing on its own, so every closer here is this repository's: one per object, because `unevaluatedProperties` stops at the object it sits in and a root closer leaves every array item taking any property. An item this repository does not narrow still carries the `$ref` beside its closer — without it the closer sees no declared property and refuses the base's own fields.
